# Pixlr

> > Pixlr is a comprehensive online photo editing platform offering AI-powered tools for image editing, object removal, face swapping, collage creation, and format conversion.

Pixlr provides browser-based photo editing solutions including Pixlr Express, specialized AI tools for healing and object removal, creative design templates, and image format converters. The platform serves both casual users and professionals with free online tools accessible without downloads.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered photo editing
- Object removal and healing tools
- Pixlr Express editor
- Image format conversion (PNG, JPG, PDF, WebP)
- Face swap technology
- Photo collage maker
- Spot healing and retouching
- Drag-and-drop editing
- Business card design templates
- Cloud-based image editing
- Mobile app integration
- AI layout suggestions
- Free online tools
- Browser-based editor

## Core Photo Editing Tools

- [AI Photo Editor free : Pixlr Express - free ai image editing online](https://pixlr.com/express): Pixlr Express: browser-based AI photo editor with cloud capabilities
- [Pixlr Remove Object: Instantly Erase Objects From Image](https://pixlr.com/tools/remove-object-clone-tool): AI-powered Remove Object Tool for automatic photo cleanup and editing
- [Erase Object From Photo Online: Perfect Your Images Instantly](https://pixlr.com/tools/heal-tool): Pixlr's Heal/Repair Tool for removing objects and correcting imperfections

## AI Creative Tools

- [AI Face Swap online | High quality Swapping of Faces](https://pixlr.com/face-swap): High-quality AI Face Swap tool for transforming photos online
- [Photo Collage Maker: Create Free Collages Online](https://pixlr.com/photo-collage): Free photo collage maker with drag-and-drop layouts and AI suggestions

## Design Templates & Creators

- [Custom Business Card Templates - Design For Free With Pixlr](https://pixlr.com/design/business-card-maker): Business card template designer with customization and download options

## Image Format Converters

- [WEBP To PDF Converter: Convert Images Online In Seconds](https://pixlr.com/converter/webp-to-pdf): Free WebP to PDF converter tool with instant secure conversions
